title: Ed Sheeran Addresses War in Gaza After Macklemore Is Dropped From Tour
summary: Back onstage, Sheeran acknowledged “mistakes” over the departure of supporting acts, and discussed the “horrific” attack on Israel and the “humanitarian crisis” in Gaza.
